recommendation_summary: Set up a single hosted heartbeat monitor that `nightly-sync` pings after it finishes, so the user gets an email if the ping hasn't arrived by 03:00 plus normal runtime, and test it by skipping a ping once.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker for this fix.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends its own email, so a startup crash also disables notification.
labels.Checked myself: From the facts you supplied, four startup failures went unnoticed and no independent alert exists.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert, turns down the Synology and Docker setup, and every labelled line comes before the recommendation and is grounded in the given facts.
